tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up DNS records of one type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SOA, TXT, SRV) for a domain using public resolvers.

tools.name: dns_propagation_check
tools.description: Query a domain on about 40 public resolvers in different regions and report which ones return which answers, to see whether a DNS change has propagated.

tools.name: dnssec_check
tools.description: Validate the DNSSEC chain of trust for a domain from the root down (DS, DNSKEY, RRSIG) and report each zone as secure, insecure or broken.

tools.name: mx_lookup
tools.description: List the mail exchanger (MX) records of a domain with their preferences.

tools.name: spf_lookup
tools.description: Fetch the SPF record of a domain from its authoritative name server and list its mechanisms (ip4, ip6, include, redirect, all).

tools.name: spf_validate
tools.description: Validate the SPF record of a domain: syntax, single-record rule, DNS lookup count (limit 10), void lookups, includes and the all mechanism.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: WHOIS registration data for a domain: registrar, dates, status and name servers (personal contact data is redacted by registries).

tools.name: domain_expiry
tools.description: Registration and expiry dates of a domain, with the time remaining before it expires.

tools.name: ssl_certificate_check
tools.description: Connect to a domain on port 443 and report the certificate chain: subject, issuer, validity dates, days remaining, SANs and chain details.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Ping a public host from httpfy servers (4 ICMP echo requests) and report packet loss and round-trip times. Useful to test reachability from outside your own network.

tools.name: traceroute
tools.description: Traceroute to a public host from httpfy servers (up to 10 hops). Internal hops of httpfy's own network are masked.

tools.name: ip_whois
tools.description: WHOIS / registry data for a public IPv4 address: ASN, network range, owner organisation and registry.

tools.name: ip_blacklist_check
tools.description: Check whether a public IPv4 address is listed on common DNS-based blocklists such as Spamhaus, Barracuda and SpamCop.

tools.name: mac_vendor_lookup
tools.description: Identify the manufacturer registered for a MAC address prefix (OUI) using the IEEE registry.

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: Look up the autonomous system (ASN) for a public IP address, or details for an ASN such as AS15169: name, country, announced prefixes and address counts.

tools.name: bimi_check
tools.description: Check the BIMI record of a domain, whether DMARC meets BIMI requirements, and whether the SVG logo and certificate URLs are reachable and well formed.

tools.name: caa_check
tools.description: Find the CAA records that apply to a domain (climbing to parent domains per RFC 8659) and list which certificate authorities may issue certificates.

tools.name: certificate_transparency_search
tools.description: List certificates logged in Certificate Transparency for a domain (via crt.sh): issuer, validity window and names, with a summary by issuer.

tools.name: dkim_check
tools.description: Check DKIM public keys for a domain. With a selector it checks that selector; without one it probes common selectors. Reports key type and RSA key length and flags weak or revoked keys.

tools.name: dmarc_check
tools.description: Find and explain the DMARC record of a domain (policy, pct, rua/ruf, alignment) and flag weaknesses such as p=none or missing external report authorization.

tools.name: dns_report
tools.description: Full DNS report for a domain: delegation from the root, every authoritative name server checked individually (reachability, recursion, TCP, consistency), SOA values, MX records and their reverse DNS, SPF, DMARC, DKIM and DNSSEC.

tools.name: domain_health_report
tools.description: Grade a domain A to F across 11 checks (name servers, SOA, DNSSEC, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA, HTTPS certificate, HTTP to HTTPS redirect, HSTS, IPv6), with a reason and fix for each failed check.

tools.name: mta_sts_check
tools.description: Check MTA-STS (TXT record and the HTTPS policy file, mode and MX patterns) and the TLS-RPT reporting record for a domain.

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check whether one TCP port on a public host is open, closed or filtered when tested from httpfy servers on the internet.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "dmarc_check" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Find and explain the DMARC record of a domain (policy, pct, rua/ruf, alignment) and flag weaknesses such as p=none or missing external report authorization.
